narration: Now double the depth. Six millimetres, six kilograms. Nothing else about the night changes. Same sky.
caption: अब गहराई दोगुनी करो। छह मिलीमीटर, छह किलो। रात में और कुछ नहीं बदला।
image_brief: Two pans side by side on the same straw bed at night, one holding a skin of water and the other filled to twice that level, both perfectly still.

narration: The sky still takes eighty watts. Twice the water, twice the time. Seven hours. Cutting it close.
caption: आसमान अब भी अस्सी वाट लेता है। दोगुना पानी, दोगुना समय। सात घंटे।
image_brief: An hourglass half run through standing on a cold stone ledge beside a pan of water at night, sand still falling through the neck.

narration: Now fill it like a sensible bucket. Five centimetres deep. Fifty kilograms per square metre.
caption: अब इसे किसी बाल्टी की तरह भरो। पाँच सेंटीमीटर गहरा। पचास किलो प्रति वर्ग मीटर।
image_brief: A galvanised bucket filled almost to the brim with water standing on straw in an open yard at night, the surface flat and unbroken.

narration: Same eighty watts. The answer comes out near fifty eight hours of clear night. Nearly three nights.
caption: वही अस्सी वाट। जवाब निकलता है लगभग अट्ठावन घंटे साफ़ रात। तीन रातों जैसा।
image_brief: A deep stone water trough in a courtyard at dawn, the water entirely liquid, a thin line of frost only on the stone rim above the waterline.

narration: No night is that long. That is why the pans were always shallow. Depth was the whole design.
caption: कोई रात इतनी लंबी नहीं होती। इसीलिए वे तवे हमेशा उथले रखे जाते थे।
image_brief: Several very shallow wide pans and one deep bucket together on the same straw bed at first light, ice sitting only in the shallow pans.

narration: Now the limits, because this fails more often than it works. Four things kill it.
caption: अब सीमाएँ, क्योंकि यह बनने से ज़्यादा बार बिगड़ता है। चार चीज़ें इसे मारती हैं।
image_brief: A stack of empty clay pans tipped over and abandoned in the corner of a walled yard under a heavy flat grey sky.

narration: Cloud. A cloud sits near air temperature and radiates hard through that same window. Back down at you.
caption: बादल। बादल हवा के तापमान पर होता है और उसी खिड़की से नीचे गर्मी फेंकता है।
image_brief: A thick blanket of low cloud lying over a valley at night, the town lights below glowing faintly upward into the cloud base.

narration: The hole in the ceiling closes. Net loss collapses. No frost. Cloudy nights stay mild.
caption: छत का छेद बंद। शुद्ध नुक़सान ख़त्म। पाला नहीं। बादल वाली रातें हल्की रहती हैं।
image_brief: A suburban lawn at dawn under a completely overcast sky with no frost at all, the grass green and merely damp, puddles along the path.

narration: Humidity. Water vapour absorbs at the window edges and narrows it from both sides. A muggy night will not frost.
caption: नमी। जलवाष्प खिड़की के किनारों को दोनों तरफ़ से सँकरा कर देती है।
image_brief: Night mist hanging thick over a river estuary, the far bank completely hidden, the water surface glassy and unfrozen.

narration: That is why deserts frost and coastal nights do not. Same latitude, different air. Dryness wins.
caption: इसीलिए रेगिस्तान में पाला पड़ता है और समुद्र किनारे नहीं। सूखापन जीत जाता है।
image_brief: A coastal beach at sunrise with damp dark sand, dew beaded on a beached fishing boat, no frost anywhere, heavy haze over the water.

narration: Wind. Moving air refeeds the surface faster than eighty watts can drain it. A breeze cancels the night.
caption: हवा। चलती हवा सतह को अस्सी वाट से भी तेज़ी से दोबारा गर्मी दे देती है।
image_brief: A washing line snapping in strong night wind on a rooftop, the cloth stretched out horizontal, the rail and floor bare of any frost.

narration: Which is why frost prefers dead still air. Still, clear, dry. Miss one and nothing happens.
caption: इसीलिए पाला बिल्कुल शांत हवा पसंद करता है। शांत, साफ़, सूखी। तीनों ज़रूरी।
image_brief: A perfectly still pond at night reflecting stars with mirror clarity, reeds motionless at the edge, thin ice beginning at the rim.

narration: Shelter. Anything overhead radiates back at you, so the sky view is gone. A tree is a roof.
caption: आड़। ऊपर कोई भी चीज़ गर्मी वापस देती है, और आसमान दिखना बंद। पेड़ भी छत है।
image_brief: A lawn at dawn beneath a large spreading tree, the grass under the canopy dark green while the open lawn beyond it is white with frost.

narration: That is the cloth over the plant. It is not insulation. It is blocking. A thin sheet works.
caption: यही उस कपड़े का काम है। वह गर्मी नहीं देता। वह आसमान को ढक देता है।
image_brief: A single white cotton sheet pegged over a row of seedlings in a kitchen garden at dawn, frost whitening the open soil on either side.

narration: And daylight ends it completely. Sunshine delivers around a thousand watts per square metre. Against eighty.
caption: और दिन में यह ख़त्म। धूप लगभग हज़ार वाट प्रति वर्ग मीटर देती है।
image_brief: Bright low morning sun striking a frosted metal roof, a wet line spreading across it where the frost has already gone, faint steam rising.
